prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a hit while turning left claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1264; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Reviewed the first notice of loss for a left-turn collision at an intersection. Insured states the other vehicle came through on the oncoming lane while the insured was turning. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles on file from the scene.

Entry 2: Claimant has retained counsel, who has asked that all communication go through their office. Confirmed the representation letter is in the file and updated contact preferences accordingly. No direct contact with the claimant going forward.

Entry 3: Received the claimant's medical records from the treating clinic. Diagnosis is a lumbar strain with muscle spasm. Treatment includes physical therapy and a prescribed course of anti-inflammatory medication. Records indicate the claimant has not missed more than a few days of work.

Entry 4: Spoke with defense counsel regarding liability. Based on the scene diagram and the insured's statement, the insured's left-turn path appears to have been the primary cause, though the other driver's speed is still under review. Requested the vehicle's event data recorder download to confirm speed at impact.

Entry 5: Counsel's demand package received and under review along with the medical bills. Scheduled an internal file review to evaluate the back strain treatment against the documented recovery timeline. Reserve adjustment will be considered once the review is complete.
